summary: Signing can be automated in trusted CI (OpenShift, Jenkins) by importing the GPG key as a secret and setting ANSIBLE_SIGN_GPG_PASSPHRASE; ansible-sign has stable exit codes, with 0 meaning success.
questions: How do I sign projects in a CI pipeline?
How do I pass the GPG passphrase to ansible-sign non-interactively?
What does ansible-sign exit code 0 mean?
